summary: Limoneira Company (LMNR) disclosed via an 8-K that its subsidiary, Windfall Investors, received a termination notice from Peak Holdings, LLC regarding the Purchase and Sale Agreement dated April 14, 2026. Under the deal, Limoneira agreed to sell an 80% undivided tenant-in-common interest in its Paso Robles, California real estate parcels. Peak Holdings terminated during the due diligence review period per Section 5.5, and its $500,000 cash deposit will be returned. No price/share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The termination removes the prospective sale; the property remains fully owned by Limoneira. No regulatory clock or break fee is noted. Watch for any revised sale process or potential buyer.
